transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just... really tired lately. Not the kind where you just need a nap. It's more like... I don't know, even doing small things, like emptying the dishwasher or trying to read for this certificate class I'm taking, it just feels like too much effort.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don't know if sad is the right word. I mean... I mostly just feel drained. I haven't really thought about it.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?

I guess not really. I just... kind of stopped caring about the things that usually make me feel like myself. 

Like, I haven't been sketching, or... going to gallery openings. I usually like cooking, or doing yoga... maybe playing tennis with a friend. But lately I just... I don't know. I haven't really wanted to do any of it.
Do you still get pleasure from the things you do?
I don't really know. I guess not. Um... mostly it just feels like I'm going through the motions. I haven't really noticed feeling good about... well, much of anything lately.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself?
No... um, no. I haven't. I don't really think about doing anything like that.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... I guess maybe about three months? It's just been this... quiet stretch, I guess. Just feeling really tired and... not having much interest in things. But yeah, around three months.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?

Um... I guess so. My jeans are a bit looser. I'm not... I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, it's just... my appetite has been off. Sometimes I'll get to the end of the day and realize I've only really had coffee and... maybe a few bites of something. So... yeah.
Have you had any days in the past month where you felt somewhat better than others?
Um... no, not really. I don't... I haven't really noticed any difference. They kind of all just feel the same, I guess.
Have you had any difficulty concentrating or making decisions lately?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It's... it's just hard to figure out what to do. Like, I'll have my planning app open on my phone and... I just sit there. I can't decide if I should work on a class assignment, or pay a bill, or... even just start dinner. So I just... I don't know, I end up doing none of it for a while.
Have you had any significant social withdrawal or avoided being around other people lately?

Um... yeah, I guess. I just... I haven't really been seeing my friends. I used to do some art stuff with them, but I just kind of stopped going. And at home... my husband's been doing a lot more because I just... I can't seem to get to the housework or the cooking. Everything's just piling up... the bills, my certificate classes... I just can't seem to follow through on anything right now.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual or feeling like you're speeding up in your thoughts or actions?

Um... mostly just slower, I guess. I haven't really noticed any speeding up. But sometimes it just... it feels like my body is moving through wet cement. And... I don't know, even if my husband asks me a really simple question, it can just... take me a weirdly long time to actually answer him.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about anything lately?
Um... no, I don't think so. I haven't really felt... guilty, or anything like that. Just... no.
Have you had any periods where your symptoms were significantly worse than they are now?
Um... no, not really. It's just... been pretty much like this, I think. Nothing really worse than this.
Have you been experiencing significant distress or impairment in your social, occupational, or other areas of functioning due to these feelings?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Things are just... kind of piling up. Like my certificate classes... I'm pretty far behind. And just regular stuff at home, like bills and meals. My husband has had to step in and do a lot of it lately because I just... I can't seem to follow through on things. And I haven't really been seeing my friends either... or doing my art stuff. It's just... hard to keep it all organized right now.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
Um... I don't know. I guess I try not to think about the future too much right now. It's just... I'm not really sure.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy, but now find you no longer take pleasure in?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I just... I haven't really been doing much. I used to sketch a lot, and... go to gallery openings, things like that. But I just... I don't really care about it right now. Same with cooking, or yoga... even playing tennis. I just... I don't really have the interest.
Would you say that your feelings of tiredness and lack of interest in activities are mild, moderate, or severe?
Um... probably just mild, I guess. It's... I don't know, it's not like I can't get out of bed or anything. Just... yeah, mild, I suppose.
Would you say that your lack of interest in activities and feelings of tiredness are interfering with your daily life a lot, or just a little?

Um... maybe a little? Or... I guess maybe more than a little. I'm taking some certificate classes and I've kind of fallen behind. And... things around the house are just piling up. Like bills, and making meals, things like that. My husband has been doing most of it lately. I just... I can't seem to keep things organized or follow through with anything. And I haven't really been seeing my friends or doing my art stuff either. So... yeah, I guess it's interfering.
Would you say your feelings of tiredness and lack of interest are causing significant problems in your daily life or are they more manageable?

Um... yeah, I mean... like I was just saying, I guess it's a significant problem. I just... I can't seem to keep anything organized or follow through with my plans. That's why my husband has had to step in so much with the house stuff... the bills and the meals. And... I'm falling behind in my coursework. I've just kind of pulled back from everyone, my friends, my art... so... yeah. I guess it's significant.
Would you say your feelings of tiredness and lack of interest are causing you more distress or impairment now compared to when they first started?
Um... I'm not really sure. It's... it's hard to compare, I guess. I haven't really thought about it like that. It just... is what it is right now.
